queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT trader_type, analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(analysis_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT trader_type, analysis_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT trader_type, analysis_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share;
